hypotheses.T0_rotation_is_an_exact_change_of_basis: For every layer and rotation, inverse-transforming every rotated coordinate reconstructs the native product delta and MLP write with maximum relative error below 2e-5.
hypotheses.T1_layer0_native_family_axes_are_privile: At rank 128, Layer-0 family-frozen native coordinates exceed the median matched-rotation downstream fidelity by at least 0.05 on both FineWeb and TinyStories.
hypotheses.T2_native_privilege_weakens_by_layer1: The rank-128 native-minus-rotation family-fidelity advantage is at least 0.03 larger in Layer 0 than Layer 1 on both corpora.
hypotheses.T3_native_family_banks_are_specific: At rank 256, correct native family banks exceed cyclic wrong-family banks by at least 0.05 downstream fidelity in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.T4_rotated_family_banks_retain_specifici: At rank 256, the median rotated correct-family bank exceeds its cyclic wrong-family bank by at least 0.03 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.T5_family_banks_transfer_ood: For each layer and basis, TinyStories rank-256 family fidelity retains at least 75% of FineWeb fidelity.
hypotheses.T6_layer0_native_oracle_is_sparser: At rank 128, Layer-0 per-example native-oracle fidelity exceeds the median rotated-oracle fidelity by at least 0.05 on both corpora.
hypotheses.T7_layer1_requires_context_routing: At rank 256, Layer-1 native per-example oracle fidelity exceeds its frozen family-bank fidelity by at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.T8_rotated_family_selection_is_not_rando: At rank 256, the median rotated family bank exceeds matched fixed random rotated coordinates by at least 0.05 in every layer and corpus.
hypotheses.T9_small_native_banks_are_useful: Rank-32 native family banks reach at least 0.20 downstream fidelity in every layer and corpus.
